title: Norway – Repair, maintenance and associated services related to railways and other equipment – Dynamic purchasing system for signal installer services.
description: Bane NOR SF intends to establish a dynamic purchasing system for signal mounting services. The scheme is nationwide and can be used by all regions and stretches/lines where the need arises.

title: France – Electrical machinery, apparatus, equipment and consumables; lighting – Référencement de sociétés pour l'acquisition d'infrastructures de recharge pour véhicules électriques et services associés
description: Le présent Système de Qualification (SdQ) a pour objet de sélectionner un ou plusieurs opérateurs économiques en vue de la passation de marchés spécifiques portant sur l'acquisition d'infrastructures de recharge pour véhicules électriques et services associés. Il est destiné aux Bénéficiaires de la CATP, en leur qualité d'Entité adjudicatrice telle que définie à l'article L1212-3 4° du Code de la Commande Publique (CCP) au titre de leur activité d'exploitation de réseaux destinés à fournir un service au public dans le domaine du transport de voyageurs. Le présent avis sert de moyen d'appel à la concurrence.

title: Norway – Medical equipments – Dynamic purchasing system for medical technical equipment.
description: The contracting authority would like a dynamic purchasing system that shall cover the need for the procurement of technical medicine equipment for projects. This includes, among other things: Nursing beds, bedside tables and additional equipment. Mattresses Moving aids Small aids Passenger lifts and sails The scheme does not include "health furniture" such as sitting groups, dining tables, recliners, cupboards for storing etc.

title: Qualification Scheme for Climate credits
description: The Qualification Scheme concerns the supply of carbon dioxide removal (CDR) credits from nature-based, hybrid and engineered CDR solutions including, but not limited to, reforestation, blue carbon, biochar, bioenergy with carbon dioxide capture and storage (BECCS) and direct air carbon dioxide capture and storage (DACCS) for the purpose of offsetting Copenhagen Airports’ residual scope 1, scope 2 and scope 3 category 6 (business travel) emissions in line with applicable Airport Carbon Accreditation carbon offsetting requirements.

title: Denmark – Purchase of CO2 emission credits – Qualification Scheme for Climate credits
description: The Qualification Scheme concerns the supply of carbon dioxide removal (CDR) credits from nature-based, hybrid and engineered CDR solutions including, but not limited to, reforestation, blue carbon, biochar, bioenergy with carbon dioxide capture and storage (BECCS) and direct air carbon dioxide capture and storage (DACCS) for the purpose of offsetting Copenhagen Airports’ residual scope 1, scope 2 and scope 3 category 6 (business travel) emissions in line with applicable Airport Carbon Accreditation carbon offsetting requirements.

title: KD_VH.550 Vildthegn - dynamisk indkøbssystem
description: Det dynamiske indkøbssystem udbydes til brug for opsætning, renovering eller udskiftning af hegn. Arbejdet vil omfatte en række mindre opgaver, som skal udføres i hele Danmark. Kvalificerede ansøgere kan optages i det dynamiske indkøbssystem, uanset om de kan løse opgaver i hele landet eller kun lokalt. Der anmodes om tilbud på de konkrete opgaver hos de virksomheder, som optages i det dynamiske indkøbssystem. Se nærmere om fremgangsmåden i udbudsmaterialet. Oplysningerne om varighed i pkt. 5.1.3 er foreløbige, idet det dynamiske indkøbssystem forventes anvendt, indtil den anslåede kontraktværdi er opbrugt.

title: Copenhagen Airports: Qualification system Conditions for Qualification Scheme for Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)
description: The Qualification system concerns the supply of Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) and associated environmental attribute certificates for the purpose of reducing Copenhagen Airports’ CO2 emissions from scope 3 category 6 (business travel). The purpose of the Qualification system is to establish a list of qualified companies that Copenhagen Airports A/S may invite to specific tenders, in relation to the supply of SAF to CPH. The Qualification system is implemented under Article 77 of the Utilities Directive (Directive 2014/25).
